integrity: Every canonical binary order-five cycle is enumerated twice by complete independent constructions; every cut is checked against both arch counting and shortest-absent-subsequence dynamic programming. Complete row-level CSV is included.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite census for binary orders 2 through 5; no higher-order theorem or structural characterization of all classes. No independent external mathematical verification or definitive publication-priority assessment.
title: The first cut-sensitive optimal subsequence-universality spectrum of binary de Bruijn cycles
